cases.sentence: Проповедь в силе ___ Братья, когда я пришел к вам.
cases.translation: When I came to you, brothers.
cases.explain: The phrase 'в силе Духа' (in the power of the Spirit) uses the genitive after 'силе'.

cases.sentence: Я решил не знать ничего, кроме Иисуса Христа и притом ___.
cases.translation: For I determined not to know anything except Jesus Christ and him crucified.
cases.explain: Parallel structure with 'Иисуса Христа' uses the accusative form here shown as genitive.

cases.sentence: Я пришел к вам слабым, полным страха и ___.
cases.translation: I was with you in weakness, in fear, and in much trembling.
cases.explain: The adjective 'полным' (full) takes the genitive case for the thing it is full of.

cases.translation: But to us, God revealed them through the Spirit.
cases.explain: The instrumental case 'Духом' indicates the means through which God revealed these things.

cases.sentence: Кто может знать мысли человека, кроме его собственного ___?
cases.translation: For who among men knows the things of a man, except the spirit of the man?
cases.explain: The preposition 'кроме' (except) requires the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Также и замыслов Бога никто не знает, кроме ___ Божьего.
cases.translation: No one knows the things of God, except God's Spirit.
cases.explain: The preposition 'кроме' (except) requires the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Об этом мы возвещаем не словами человеческой мудрости, но словами, которым нас научил ___.
cases.translation: We speak these things in words taught by the Holy Spirit.
cases.explain: The nominative case is used for the subject that performed the teaching.

cases.sentence: Мы объясняем духовные истины словами, которым нас учит ___.
cases.translation: Spiritual things are compared with spiritual words.
cases.explain: The nominative case is the subject of the verb 'учит' (teaches).

reading.ru: Когда я пришел к вам, то мои слова не отличались ни красноречием, ни особой мудростью.
reading.question: How did Paul describe his speech when he came to the Corinthians?
options: His words lacked eloquence and special wisdom
His words were full of human wisdom
reading.correct: His words lacked eloquence and special wisdom
reading.explain: Paul says his words did not distinguish themselves by eloquence or special wisdom.

reading.ru: И моя весть и моя проповедь были не в убедительных словах человеческой мудрости, но в проявлении силы Духа.
reading.question: What did Paul rely on instead of human wisdom?
reading.explain: Paul relied on demonstration of the Spirit and power, not persuasive words of wisdom.

reading.ru: Мудрость же мы возвещаем среди людей духовно зрелых, но это не мудрость этого мира.
reading.question: What kind of wisdom does Paul proclaim to the spiritually mature?
options: Only practical wisdom for daily life
The wisdom of philosophers and scholars
reading.explain: Paul speaks God's wisdom among the spiritually mature, not the wisdom of this world.

reading.ru: Нет, мы говорим о тайной мудрости Божией, которая до сих пор была скрыта, но еще до сотворения мира предназначена для нашей славы.
reading.question: When was God's hidden wisdom intended for our glory?
options: Before the creation of the world
During the time of the prophets
reading.correct: Before the creation of the world
reading.explain: God foreordained this wisdom before the worlds for believers' glory.

reading.ru: Недуховный человек не принимает того, что приходит от Духа Божьего, он считает это глупостью.
reading.question: Why can't the natural man accept spiritual things?
options: They are foolishness to him and require spiritual discernment
He knows too much about the world
He has studied philosophy too much
reading.correct: They are foolishness to him and require spiritual discernment
reading.explain: The natural man doesn't receive spiritual things because they are foolishness to him.

reading.question: What do believers possess according to Paul?
reading.explain: Paul concludes that believers have the mind of Christ.
